description: This file defines a mock AI client class for testing and development purposes, providing static responses for summarization, quiz generation, and explanation functionalities.

classes.name: MockAIClient
classes.description: A mock AI client designed to give deterministic, non-networked responses for summarization, quiz generation, and explanation tasks.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Provides a mock summary of the given text or content ID.

methods.name: generateQuiz
methods.description: Generates mock quiz questions based on provided text or content ID.

methods.name: explainELI5
methods.description: Provides a simplified explanation suitable for a 5-year-old.

methods.name: summarize({ text = "", contentId = "" })
methods.description: Summarizes provided text or content ID in a mock, deterministic way.

methods.name: generateQuiz({ text = "", contentId = "", n = 5 })
methods.description: Generates a set of mock quiz questions.

methods.name: explainELI5({ text = "", contentId = "" })
methods.description: Explains content in simple terms for a young audience.
